nodes.label: pybind11 _sentencepiece
nodes.desc: PYBIND11_MODULE(_sentencepiece) exposing SentencePieceProcessor, ThreadPool and Trainer to Python with GIL release.

nodes.label: SentencePieceProcessor::Encode
nodes.desc: Normalize, run the model, then PopulateSentencePieceText with surface/begin/end alignment back to the raw input.

nodes.label: PopulateSentencePieceText
nodes.desc: Maps normalized pieces back through norm_to_orig offsets to fill SentencePieceText protos.

nodes.label: SentencePieceProcessor::Decode
nodes.desc: Concatenates pieces, drops control tokens, byte-falls-back and reverses the U+2581 whitespace escape.

nodes.label: Normalizer::Normalize
nodes.desc: Trie-driven charsmap replacement plus add_dummy_prefix, remove_extra_whitespaces and escape_whitespaces.

nodes.label: PrefixMatcher::PrefixMatch
nodes.desc: Longest-match over user-defined symbols; matched spans are frozen before segmentation.

nodes.label: ModelInterface
nodes.desc: Shared base: InitializePieces builds pieces_ and reserved_id_map_; virtual Encode/Decode/NBestEncode/SampleEncode.

nodes.label: PieceToId
nodes.desc: flat_hash_map lookup with reserved ids checked first, falling back to unk_id_.

nodes.label: InitializePieces
nodes.desc: Walks ModelProto.pieces, records unk/bos/eos/pad ids and validates byte-fallback coverage.

nodes.label: unigram::Model
nodes.desc: Holds piece log-probs; Encode delegates to the optimized one-pass Viterbi over the lattice.

nodes.label: Model::EncodeOptimized
nodes.desc: Lattice-free left-to-right Viterbi that tracks best hypotheses per position with score recentering.

nodes.label: Model::PopulateNodes
nodes.desc: Common-prefix search inserts every vocabulary piece matching a suffix of the input as a lattice node.

nodes.label: bpe::Model::SampleEncode
nodes.desc: Linked-list symbols plus an agenda priority queue; pops best-scoring pairs, optional BPE-dropout alpha.

nodes.label: word::Model::Encode
nodes.desc: Whole-word lookup with unk pieces for out-of-vocabulary words.

nodes.label: char::Model::Encode
nodes.desc: Splits normalized text into one piece per UTF-8 character.

nodes.label: ModelFactory
nodes.desc: Switch on TrainerSpec::ModelType returning unigram/bpe/word/char Model instances.

nodes.label: Lattice
nodes.desc: DAG of nodes over the normalized string with begin_nodes_/end_nodes_ adjacency per position.

nodes.label: Lattice::Viterbi
nodes.desc: Forward max-score pass storing backtrace pointers, then reconstructs the best path via EOS.

nodes.label: Lattice::PopulateMarginal
nodes.desc: Forward-backward style pass computing each node's expected frequency for EM.

nodes.label: SentencePieceTrainer::Train
nodes.desc: Parses flags or keyword-arg maps, applies defaults, then drives the trainer components.

nodes.label: TrainerFactory
nodes.desc: Creates the TrainerInterface subclass matching model_type and the matching TrainerModel.

nodes.label: UnigramTrainer::Train
nodes.desc: Seed pieces, then EM sub-iterations with pruning until vocab_size is reached.

nodes.label: MakeSeedSentencePieces
nodes.desc: Harvests frequent substrings (or all chars) as the initial oversized candidate vocabulary.

nodes.label: Trainer::RunEStep
nodes.desc: Runs lattice Viterbi/forward-backward over sampled sentences to accumulate expected counts.

nodes.label: Trainer::RunMStep
nodes.desc: Turns expected frequencies into fresh piece log-probs, kept in log space for stability.

nodes.label: Trainer::PruneSentencePieces
nodes.desc: Keeps the pieces whose removal hurts the likelihood least, converging to vocab_size.

nodes.label: TrainerInterface
nodes.desc: LoadSentences with shuffling/sampling, character_coverage required_chars_, Save of .model/.vocab.

nodes.label: TrainerInterface::LoadSentences
nodes.desc: Streams input files or sentence_iterator, filters empty lines, computes required_chars_.

nodes.label: IsValidSentencePiece
nodes.desc: Enforces max_length, disallowed whitespace rules and required_chars_ membership for candidates.

nodes.label: TrainerInterface::Serialize
nodes.desc: Packs pieces, trainer_spec and normalizer_spec into the output ModelProto.

nodes.label: spm_train main
nodes.desc: CLI entry that maps command-line flags to SentencePieceTrainer::Train.

nodes.label: ModelProto
nodes.desc: message ModelProto: repeated SentencePiece pieces = 1 plus trainer_spec and normalizer_spec.

nodes.label: TrainerSpec
nodes.desc: message TrainerSpec: model_type (default UNIGRAM), vocab_size (default 8000), inputs, coverage flags.
